items: NEW: **Import/Export** — backup and restore all your lists and categories via a single .json file
NEW: **Microsoft To Do import** — bring in your task lists from Microsoft To Do (list only)
NEW: **Google Keep import** — import your Keep notes that are formatted as simple checklists (list only)
NEW: **Update** button in About — check for the latest version right from the app
NEW: **Change List** button in About — read the full version history without leaving the app
NEW: About page redesigned
NEW: New app icon, more splash screens & active frame images
FIX: Checking or unchecking an item now updates the visual immediately — no need to leave and re-enter the list
FIX: Unchecking an item no longer reverts to checked after re-entering the list
IMPROVE: You can now switch to dark mode instantly without restarting the app
IMPROVE: Turning off SmartFrame in the settings will disabled related options
NEW: **Copy** individual items from the context menu
IMPROVE: List and item sizes adjusted to match action bar button dimensions
FIX: Active Frame now displays the full list on all devices — previously capped at 4 items and misaligned on non-Q10/Q20/Q5 hardware
FIX: Last item on the Active Frame no longer hidden behind the app icon, name and close button
FIX: Highlight no longer fails to reset when checking an item in the list tab
NEW: Reddit button added in About
IMPROVE: Category and list deletion toasts now appear centered instead of at the bottom
NEW: **SmartDetection** — enter multiple items at once, separated by commas, semicolons or newlines
NEW: **SmartCopy** — paste from clipboard and items are split automatically
NEW: **Single Entry** — add items one by one with an optional note
NEW: Organize lists into custom **categories** with separate sidebar tabs
NEW: **All Lists** tab shows every list across all categories, sorted A–Z
NEW: **Select More** to bulk-delete multiple lists or items at once
NEW: Share a full list via BBM, SMS, Email and other installed apps
NEW: All data saved locally to SQLite — no internet connection needed
NEW: **Dark Theme** for OLED devices — applies after an app restart
NEW: **SmartFrame** — navigate and tick items directly from the Active Frame without reopening the app
NEW: **Smooth Scroll** mode — tilt the device to scroll through the Active Frame list; hold Vol Up to check an item
NEW: **Volume Key Navigation** mode — use Vol Up/Down to move between items and Mute to check
NEW: **SmartFrame Info** — optionally show the list name, completion count and a progress bar on the Active Frame
